text:
Get started

Use Ramp at your company, or build for others.

For customersHave a Ramp account? Create credentials and make your first API call.For partnersBuilding an integration for other businesses? Start with the partner program.Get sandbox accessDon't have a Ramp account? Request a sandbox to start building right away.

Use cases

End-to-end build journeys that span multiple Ramp products.

AI AgentsConnect agents to Ramp via MCP or the CLI. Read data, process approvals, make purchases.AI Usage TrackingLet customers connect Ramp, then broadcast their AI usage events into Ramp spend analytics.ApplicationsPartner-led customer onboarding. Pre-fill a Ramp application, capture OAuth, track status via webhooks.Bill PaymentsCreate approved bills via API and pay vendors end-to-end. Pick a payment method, attach docs, run 3-way match.Customized ApproversRoute approvals based on accounting dimensions via matrix tables.ERP IntegrationsTwo-way sync between Ramp and your customer ERP — chart of accounts in, transactions and bills out.Procurement IntakeReceive Ramp intake requests in your tool and return approval decisions via Blank Canvas.Spend programsThe recurring-budget pattern. Mint funds from a template so policy stays consistent.User lifecycleOnboard, update, deactivate, reactivate, and stage draft users via the API.Virtual cardsIssue virtual cards backed by funds. Expose them server-side (Vault) or in the browser (iframe).

Products

Editorial hubs for each Ramp product surface — concepts, mental model, where to go next.

AI IndexBusiness AI adoption metrics across categories and tools.Bill PayBills, draft bills, payments, vendors, 3-way match.CardsVirtual, physical, and agent cards. Every card draws against a fund.Custom RecordsDefine your own data model in Ramp.ProcurementIntake requests, purchase orders, vendor onboarding.Ramp RatePublic benchmarks for software pricing and category spend.ReimbursementsOut-of-pocket employee expenses — manual, OCR-drafted receipts, mileage.Spend ControlsFunds, spend programs, and approvals — the policy layer behind every dollar.UsersThe people on a Ramp account. Status, identity, async creation.

Conventions

API rules and cross-cutting patterns. Reference while building.

Data relationshipsHow Ramp resources connect to each other.Deferred tasksAsync work, polling, lifecycle.ErrorsStatus codes, error shapes, debugging.Monetary valuesCurrency, precision, ISO codes.PaginationCursor-based, page sizes, sort order.Rate limits and timeoutsQuotas, backoff, headers to read.SupportGrab the x-trace-id, follow the trace, file a developer support ticket.WebhooksSubscribe, verify signatures, retry.

Canonical OpenAPI schema for the Developer API: /openapi/developer-api.json.
